nom: Thayers Blemish Clearing Toner with 2% Salicylic Acid

segments.oily: Some oily-skin reviewers report the toner works fine without irritation, and one describes it as better suited to oily than combination or dry skin.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin most often report the toner is too drying or causes tightness and flaking, though a couple describe it as non-drying and gentle even for dry skin.
segments.combination: Combination and combo-acne-prone reviewers give mixed results, from no visible effect on acne to clear improvement and pore-minimizing benefits.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers split sharply: several describe burning, redness, or irritation, while others call it calming, non-irritating, and suitable for sensitive or redness-prone skin.
segments.mature: One 42-year-old reviewer with hormonal acne reports a fast, clear improvement in her skin.

concerns.aging: Only one reviewer ties the product to an age-related concern, reporting hormonal acne cleared quickly at 42; no other aging-specific claims (fine lines, firmness) appear.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers describe the toner as drying or tightening, especially with frequent use, but a comparable number say it is non-drying, refreshing, and even adds moisture back to the skin.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report reduced redness or a soothing, calming effect (including from witch hazel), while a few others report the opposite — burning that left the face visibly red and irritated.
concerns.barrier: A handful of reviewers report peeling, flaking, or a stripped feeling, especially with daily use on dry skin, while others emphasize it never leaves skin feeling stripped.
concerns.spots: Most reviewers report visible reduction in blemishes, faster healing of individual pimples, and fewer new breakouts; a few report no real change or even an initial small breakout.
concerns.blemishes: The majority describe clear improvement in acne and blemishes, including cystic-type pimples drying up faster and long-standing acne finally responding; a minority (about four) report no improvement despite consistent use.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin report it helps control oil, shine, and buildup around the hairline and ears without over-drying, with no dissenting reports on this specific point.

aspects.libelle: Leaves skin feeling dry or tight

extraits.texte: I have oily sensitive acne prone combination skin, and while yes this got rid of some of my breakouts and shrunk my pores it BUUUUURRRRNNNNSSSS. On my skin and the vapors from my eyes, especially after taking a shower. Good product but not for me.

I received this product complimentary from Thayers & Influenster for my honest review. I was so excited about this line as I love skin care that is gentle on the skin especially for someone with redness like myself I was looking forward to having a new fave. I was a bit disappointed though as this whole line seemed to be wayyy too drying for my skin. I found this product to smell really well but didn't really notice any good difference in my skin only more dryness than usual which I do not need flaky skin . I see this working better for someone without skin sensitivity and for someone with oil skin only not combo.

I really like the brand Thayers, but I think their hydrating line is a bit better for my skin type. This product 100% helped to clear my acne and minimize the breakouts I have, however my skin feels a bit tight after applying. It is not as drying as the pads however and I think the aloe vera helps with that. I do have very dry skin to begin with, so this may be more of an oily skin product. It definitely helped with my acne though and I would consider this a good affordable BHA toner!

I am 42 with some hormonal acne. I just can never seem to get a clear face for the past few years. Once one giant blemish goes away two more pop up. I have tried so many products. This toner works and it works pretty fast. I saw a huge improvement within the first few days of use. I have been using it for about two weeks now and my face is clear.

extraits.titre: Effective toner for sensitive skin and acne!
extraits.texte: I absolutely love Thayers Blemish Clearing facial toner. This product contains LemonGrass, Aloe and Salicylic Acid. I also suggest using this once a day and then gradually going up to 3 times a day. This routine is absolutely fantastic. This toner makes skin firm while clearing blemishes. I love the scent of the LemonGrass. Previously I used Thayers Rose toner and now I prefer the Blemish Clearning toner a thousand times more. It causes zero irritation and truly makes a difference on my acne. I highly recommend this to anyone!

2% salicylic acid acne treatment toner with 91% natural origin ingredients. I have acne prone combo skin, and this toner works well for me, it is non-drying, and my skin left feeling comfortable after I apply this toner. I use it once a day, and It helps me keep my skin clean and acne free, also it is non-irritating. It is affordable, and smells like lemongrass, also this toner has no alcohol in the ingredients!

Obsessed with this toner it's all I use it cleanses my skin so good without over drying it as I have dry skin. The smell is a clean calm scent no irritation. I love using this to really deep clean my face after my face wash.
